cambrian-explosion.summary: A geologically rapid diversification in which most major animal body plans first appear in the fossil record.

land-plants.summary: Life moved out of the water, building the soils and drawing down the carbon dioxide that made a terrestrial biosphere possible.

tetrapods-on-land.summary: Lobe-finned fish with limb-like fins moved into shallows and then onto land. Every amphibian, reptile, bird and mammal is descended from them, which is why our limbs have the same bone pattern.
